            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #f0f0f0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        
        .card-title .icon {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #11998e 0%, #38ef7d 100%);
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
            font-size: 12px;
        }
        
        /* 查询区域 */
        .search-section {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            align-items: flex-end;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        
        .form-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        
        .form-group label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #333;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        
        .form-group input,
        .form-group select {
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border: 1px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            min-width: 240px;
        }
        
        .form-group input:focus,
        .form-group select:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #11998e;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17, 153, 142, 0.1);
        }
        
        .btn {
            padding: 10px 24px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        
        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #11998e 0%, #38ef7d 100%);
            color: white;
        }
        
        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(17, 153, 142, 0.4);
        }
        
        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            color: white;
        }
        
        .btn-success:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
        }
        
        .btn-danger {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eb3349 0%, #f45c43 100%);
            color: white;
        }
        
        .btn-danger:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(235, 51, 73, 0.4);
        }
        
        .btn-warning {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%);
            color: white;
        }
        
        .btn-warning:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 87, 108, 0.4);
        }
        
        .btn-secondary {
            background: #f5f5f5;
            color: #333;
            border: 1px solid #ddd;
        }
        
        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: #e8e8e8;
        }
        
        .btn-outline {
            background: transparent;
            color: #11998e;
            border: 1px solid #11998e;
        }
        
        .btn-outline:hover {
            background: #11998e;
            color: white;
        }
        
        .btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none !important;
        }
        
        .btn-sm {
            padding: 6px 12px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }
        
        /* 统计卡片 */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        
        .stat-card {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }
        
        .stat-icon {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 24px;
        }
        
        .stat-icon.green {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(17, 153, 142, 0.1) 0%, rgba(56, 239, 125, 0.1) 100%);
        }
        
        .stat-icon.yellow {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.1) 0%, rgba(255, 152, 0, 0.1) 100%);
        }
        
        .stat-icon.red {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(235, 51, 73, 0.1) 0%, rgba(244, 92, 67, 0.1) 100%);
        }
        
        .stat-icon.blue {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.1) 0%, rgba(118, 75, 162, 0.1) 100%);
        }
        
        .stat-info h3 {
            font-size: 28px;
            color: #1a1a2e;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        
        .stat-info p {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }
        
        /* 数据对比区域 */
        .compare-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
        }
        
        .compare-panel {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        
        .compare-panel.local {
            border: 2px solid #667eea;
        }
        
        .compare-panel.remote {
            border: 2px solid #11998e;
        }
        
        .panel-header {
            padding: 16px 20px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        
        .compare-panel.local .panel-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
            color: white;
        }
        
        .compare-panel.remote .panel-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #11998e 0%, #38ef7d 100%);
            color: white;
        }
        
        .panel-header h3 {
            font-size: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        
        .panel-body {
            padding: 20px;
        }
        
        /* 数据项 */
        .data-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
        }
        
        .data-item.match {
            border-left-color: #28a745;
        }
        
        .data-item.mismatch {
            border-left-color: #ffc107;
            background: #fff9e6;
        }
        
        .data-item.local-only {
            border-left-color: #dc3545;
            background: #fff5f5;
        }
        
        .data-item.remote-only {
            border-left-color: #17a2b8;
            background: #e7f7ff;
        }
        
        .data-item .label {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #666;
            min-width: 140px;
        }
        
        .data-item .value {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #1a1a2e;
            font-weight: 500;
            flex: 1;
            text-align: right;
            margin-right: 12px;
        }
        
        .data-item .value.highlight {
            color: #e74c3c;
            background: #fff0f0;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        
        .sync-btn {
            padding: 4px 10px;
            font-size: 11px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #11998e 0%, #38ef7d 100%);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        
        .sync-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }
        
        /* 受益所有人卡片 */
        .beneficiary-card {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        }
        
        .beneficiary-card-header {
            padding: 14px 20px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        
        .beneficiary-card-header h4 {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: #1a1a2e;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        
        .beneficiary-card-body {
            padding: 16px 20px;
        }
        
        /* 状态标签 */
        .status-tag {
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        
        .status-tag.consistent {
            background: #d4edda;
            color: #155724;
        }
        
        .status-tag.inconsistent {
            background: #fff3cd;
            color: #856404;
        }
        
        .status-tag.local-extra {
            background: #f8d7da;
            color: #721c24;
        }
        
        .status-tag.remote-extra {
            background: #cce5ff;
            color: #004085;
        }
        
        /* 操作按钮区 */
        .action-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 24px;
            padding-top: 20px;
            border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
        }
        
        /* 提示信息 */
        .alert {
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        
        .alert-info {
            background: #e7f3ff;
            color: #0066cc;
            border: 1px solid #b3d7ff;
        }
        
        .alert-success {
            background: #d4edda;
            color: #155724;
            border: 1px solid #c3e6cb;
        }
        
        .alert-warning {
            background: #fff3cd;
            color: #856404;
            border: 1px solid #ffeeba;
        }
        
        .alert-error {
            background: #f8d7da;
            color: #721c24;
            border: 1px solid #f5c6cb;
        }
        
        /* 模态框 */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1000;
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }
        
        .modal-overlay.show {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }
        
        .modal {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 16px;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 600px;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transform: scale(0.9);
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }
        
        .modal-overlay.show .modal {
            transform: scale(1);
        }
        
        .modal-header {
            padding: 20px 24px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        
        .modal-header h2 {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: #1a1a2e;
        }
        
        .modal-close {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border: none;
            background: #f0f0f0;
            border-radius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 18px;
            color: #666;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }
        
        .modal-close:hover {
            background: #e0e0e0;
            color: #333;
        }
        
        .modal-body {
            padding: 24px;
        }
        
        .modal-footer {
            padding: 16px 24px;
            border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        
        /* 日志列表 */
        .log-list {
            max-height: 300px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        
        .log-item {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border-left: 3px solid #11998e;
        }
        
        .log-item .time {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
        
        .log-item .content {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #333;
        }
        
        .log-item .operator {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 6px;
        }
        
        /* 空状态 */
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 60px 20px;
            color: #999;
        }
        
        .empty-state .icon {
            font-size: 48px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        
        .empty-state p {
            font-size: 14px;
        }
        
        /* 分组标题 */
        .group-title {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #666;
            margin: 16px 0 10px;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px dashed #ddd;
        }
        
        /* 图例 */
        .legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        
        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #666;
        }
        
        .legend-color {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        
        .legend-color.match {
            background: #28a745;
        }
        
        .legend-color.mismatch {
            background: #ffc107;
        }
        
        .legend-color.local-only {
            background: #dc3545;
        }
        
        .legend-color.remote-only {
            background: #17a2b8;
        }
        
        /* 差异摘要表格 */
        .diff-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }
        
        .diff-table th {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            padding: 12px;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #333;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
        }
        
        .diff-table td {
            padding: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
            color: #444;
        }
        
        .diff-table tr:hover {
            background: #f8f9fa;
        }
        
        /* 对比行 */
        .compare-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        
        .compare-cell {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
        }
        
        .compare-cell.local {
            border: 1px solid #667eea;
        }
        
        .compare-cell.remote {
            border: 1px solid #11998e;
        }
        
        .compare-cell .field-name {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #999;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        
        .compare-cell .field-value {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #1a1a2e;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        
        .compare-cell .field-value.diff {
            color: #e74c3c;
            background: #fff5f5;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        
        /* 响应式 */
        @media (max-width: 1200px) {
            .compare-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }
        
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .search-section {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
            }
            
            .form-group input {
                min-width: 100%;
            }
            
            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
            
            .compare-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- 页面标题 -->
        <div class="page-header">
            <h1>数据一致性核验与反向同步更新</h1>
            <p>核验BOMIS数据与本地留存数据一致性，支持单条数据反向同步更新，记录判定结果日志</p>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 查询区域 -->
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">🔍</span>
                核验数据查询
            </div>
            <div class="search-section">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>对公客户编号</label>
                    <input type="text" id="customerNo" placeholder="请输入对公客户编号">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>统一社会信用代码</label>
                    <input type="text" id="creditCode" placeholder="请输入统一社会信用代码">
                </div>
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="queryVerification()">
                    <span>🔍</span> 查询核验数据
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 统计卡片 -->
        <div class="stats-grid" id="statsSection" style="display: none;">
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon green">✅</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="matchCount">3</h3>
                    <p>一致项</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon yellow">⚠️</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="mismatchCount">2</h3>
                    <p>要素不一致</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon red">➖</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="localExtraCount">1</h3>
                    <p>本地多出</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon blue">➕</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="remoteExtraCount">1</h3>
                    <p>本地缺失</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 数据对比区 -->
        <div class="card" id="compareSection" style="display: none;">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">📊</span>
                数据对比结果
                <span style="margin-left: auto; font-size: 13px; font-weight: normal; color: #666;">
                    客户：<span id="displayCustomerName">示例科技有限公司</span>
                </span>
            </div>
            
            <!-- 图例 -->
            <div class="legend">
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color match"></span>
                    <span>数据一致</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color mismatch"></span>
                    <span>要素不一致</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color local-only"></span>
                    <span>本地多出</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color remote-only"></span>
                    <span>本地缺失</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="alert alert-warning">
                <span>⚠️</span>
                <span>发现数据不一致，请核查不一致原因后进行处理。反向同步仅支持单条客户数据更新，同步后数据需重新校验。</span>
            </div>
            
            <!-- 受益所有人对比列表 -->
            <div id="beneficiaryCompareList">
                <!-- 一致的数据 -->
                <div class="beneficiary-card">
                    <div class="beneficiary-card-header">
                        <h4>
                            <span>👤</span>
                            张三（身份证：110***********1234）
                        </h4>
                        <span class="status-tag consistent">✅ 数据一致</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="beneficiary-card-body">
                        <div class="compare-container">
                            <div class="compare-panel local">
                                <div class="panel-header">
                                    <h3><span>💾</span> 本地留存数据</h3>
                                </div>
                                <div class="panel-body">
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">姓名</span>
                                        <span class="value">张三</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">国籍</span>
                                        <span class="value">中国</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">联系电话</span>
                                        <span class="value">138****5678</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="compare-panel remote">
                                <div class="panel-header">
                                    <h3><span>☁️</span> BOMIS查询数据</h3>
                                </div>
                                <div class="panel-body">
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">姓名</span>
                                        <span class="value">张三</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">国籍</span>
                                        <span class="value">中国</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">联系电话</span>
                                        <span class="value">138****5678</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- 要素不一致的数据 -->
                <div class="beneficiary-card">
                    <div class="beneficiary-card-header">
                        <h4>
                            <span>👤</span>
                            李四（护照：G12345678）
                        </h4>
                        <span class="status-tag inconsistent">⚠️ 要素不一致</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="beneficiary-card-body">
                        <div class="compare-container">
                            <div class="compare-panel local">
                                <div class="panel-header">
                                    <h3><span>💾</span> 本地留存数据</h3>
                                </div>
                                <div class="panel-body">
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">姓名</span>
                                        <span class="value">李四</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item mismatch">
                                        <span class="label">联系电话</span>
                                        <span class="value highlight">139****8765</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item mismatch">
                                        <span class="label">居住地址</span>
                                        <span class="value highlight">北京市朝阳区XX路1号</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">股权比例</span>
                                        <span class="value">35%</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="compare-panel remote">
                                <div class="panel-header">
                                    <h3><span>☁️</span> BOMIS查询数据</h3>
                                    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline" style="color:white;border-color:white;" onclick="syncAllFields(2)">单条同步更新 →</button>
                                </div>
                                <div class="panel-body">
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">姓名</span>
                                        <span class="value">李四</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item mismatch">
                                        <span class="label">联系电话</span>
                                        <span class="value highlight">139****1111</span>
                                        <button class="sync-btn" onclick="syncField('phone', 'bomis')">同步至本地 →</button>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item mismatch">
                                        <span class="label">居住地址</span>
                                        <span class="value highlight">北京市海淀区YY路2号</span>
                                        <button class="sync-btn" onclick="syncField('address', 'bomis')">同步至本地 →</button>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="data-item match">
                                        <span class="label">股权比例</span>
                                        <span class="value">35%</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                        <strong>同步结果：</strong>成功
                    </p>
                </div>

                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeSuccessModal()">确定</button>
            </div>
        </div>

    <script>
        // 查询核验数据
        function queryVerification() {
            const customerNo = document.getElementById('customerNo').value;
            const creditCode = document.getElementById('creditCode').value;
            
            if (!customerNo && !creditCode) {
                alert('请输入对公客户编号或统一社会信用代码');
                return;
            }
            
            // 显示统计和对比区域
            document.getElementById('statsSection').style.display = 'grid';
            document.getElementById('compareSection').style.display = 'block';
            const queryParam = customerNo || creditCode;
            document.getElementById('displayCustomerName').textContent = '示例科技有限公司（' + queryParam + '）';
        }
        
        // 同步单个字段
        function syncField(fieldName, source) {
            document.getElementById('syncConfirmModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 同步整条数据
        function syncAllFields(id) {
            document.getElementById('syncConfirmModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 关闭同步确认模态框
        function closeSyncModal() {
            document.getElementById('syncConfirmModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            document.getElementById('confirmCheck').checked = false;
            document.getElementById('executeSyncBtn').disabled = true;
        }
        
        // 确认复选框变化
        document.getElementById('confirmCheck').addEventListener('change', function() {
            document.getElementById('executeSyncBtn').disabled = !this.checked;
        });
        
        // 执行同步
        function executSync() {
            closeSyncModal();
            // 显示成功提示
            document.getElementById('successTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN');
            document.getElementById('successModal').classList.add('show');
        }
        
        // 关闭成功提示
        function closeSuccessModal() {
            document.getElementById('successModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
        
        // 删除本地数据
        function deleteLocalData(id) {
            if (confirm('确定要删除该受益所有人的本地数据吗？此操作将记录在操作日志中。')) {
                alert('删除成功，已记录操作日志');
            }
        }
        
        // 一键录入
        function quickImport(id) {
            if (confirm('确定要将BOMIS查询数据一键录入到本地系统吗？')) {
                document.getElementById('successMsg').textContent = '已将BOMIS查询数据录入本地系统';
                document.getElementById('successTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN');
                document.getElementById('successModal').classList.add('show');
            }
        }
        
        // 确认本地数据有效
        function confirmLocalData() {
            if (confirm('确认本地数据有效？此操作将标记当前数据为已核验状态。')) {
                alert('已确认本地数据有效，操作已记录');
            }
        }
        
        // 保存反向同步数据
        function saveReverseSync() {
            // 校验数据
            alert('数据校验通过，保存成功！已记录操作日志。');
        }
        
        // 显示日志模态框
        function showLogModal() {
            document.getElementById('logModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 关闭日志模态框
        function closeLogModal() {
            document.getElementById('logModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
        
        // 导出日志
        function exportLog() {
            alert('日志导出功能开发中...');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // 设置默认日期（1年前到今天）
        function setDefaultDates() {
            const today = new Date();
            const oneYearAgo = new Date();
            oneYearAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = oneYearAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        // 页面加载时设置默认日期
        window.onload = setDefaultDates;

        // 查询功能
        function doQuery() {
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            
            if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                alert('请选择查询日期范围');
                return;
            }
            
            if (new Date(startDate) > new Date(endDate)) {
                alert('开始日期不能大于结束日期');
                return;
            }
            
            // 模拟查询
            alert('查询条件：' + startDate + ' 至 ' + endDate + '\n正在查询...');
        }

        // 重置查询
        function resetQuery() {
            setDefaultDates();
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                        <li><strong>默认查询：</strong>进入页面后默认展示从1年前到当前日期的数据。</li>
                        <li><strong>通知类型：</strong>包括政策通知、风险提示、数据更新、到期提醒等类型。</li>
                        <li><strong>附件下载：</strong>点击"附件"链接可查看附件列表，再次点击可下载对应附件。</li>

    <div class="modal-overlay" id="attachmentModal">
        <div class="modal">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <div class="modal-title">
                    <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span id="modalTitle">附件列表</span>
                </div>
                <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeAttachmentModal()">
                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
                        <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <ul class="attachment-list" id="attachmentList">
                    <!-- 附件列表将由JS动态生成 -->
                </ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // 设置默认日期（1年前到今天）
        function setDefaultDates() {
            const today = new Date();
            const oneYearAgo = new Date();
            oneYearAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = oneYearAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        window.onload = setDefaultDates;

        function doQuery() {
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            
            if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                alert('请选择查询日期范围');
                return;
            }
            
            if (new Date(startDate) > new Date(endDate)) {
                alert('开始日期不能大于结束日期');
                return;
            }
            
            alert('查询条件：' + startDate + ' 至 ' + endDate + '\n正在查询...');
        }

        function resetQuery() {
            setDefaultDates();
        }

        // 模拟附件数据
        const attachmentData = {
            1: [
                { name: '受益所有人核验新规解读.pdf', size: '2.5 MB', type: 'PDF' },
                { name: '新规要点汇总.docx', size: '680 KB', type: 'DOCX' }
            ],
            3: [
                { name: '2025Q4义务机构客户清单.xlsx', size: '1.8 MB', type: 'XLSX' }
            ],
            4: [
                { name: '存量客户核验截止提醒通知.pdf', size: '560 KB', type: 'PDF' },
                { name: '高风险客户名单.xlsx', size: '320 KB', type: 'XLSX' }
            ],
            5: [
                { name: '年度核验工作总结模板.docx', size: '890 KB', type: 'DOCX' },
                { name: '填报说明.pdf', size: '450 KB', type: 'PDF' }
            ]
        };

        function openAttachmentModal(title, id) {
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = title + ' - 附件列表';
            
            const attachments = attachmentData[id] || [];
            const listHtml = attachments.map(att => `
                <li class="attachment-item">
                    <div class="attachment-info">
                        <div class="attachment-icon">
                            <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path>
                                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div class="attachment-details">
                            <span class="attachment-name">${att.name}</span>
                            <span class="attachment-meta">${att.type} · ${att.size}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button class="download-btn" onclick="downloadFile('${att.name}')">
                        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path>
                            <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline>
                            <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line>
                        </svg>
                        下载
                    </button>
                </li>
            `).join('');
            
            document.getElementById('attachmentList').innerHTML = listHtml;
            document.getElementById('attachmentModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeAttachmentModal() {
            document.getElementById('attachmentModal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        function downloadFile(filename) {
            alert('正在下载：' + filename);
        }

        document.getElementById('attachmentModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) {
                closeAttachmentModal();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeAttachmentModal();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        td {
            padding: 14px 14px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        tbody tr {
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        tbody tr:hover {
            background: #faf5ff;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
            background: #fefbff;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(even):hover {
            background: #faf5ff;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-right {
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* 处理码标签 */
        .status-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .status-success {
            background: #dcfce7;
            color: #16a34a;
        }

        .status-error {
            background: #fee2e2;
            color: #dc2626;
        }

        .status-pending {
            background: #fef3c7;
            color: #b45309;
        }

        /* 分页 */
        .pagination {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 26px;
            padding-top: 22px;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .pagination-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .pagination-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .page-btn {
            min-width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            padding: 0 14px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            background: white;
            border-radius: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* 说明区域 */
        .description-section {
            padding: 24px 32px;
            background: #faf5ff;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .description-title {
            font-size: 17px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .description-content {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.9;
        }

        .description-content ul {
            margin-left: 24px;
        }

        .description-content li {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        /* 响应式 */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container {
                padding: 14px;
            }

            .page-header {

                gap: 18px;
            }

            .query-form {

            }

            .date-range {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }
        }
    </style>

    <script>
        // 设置默认日期（1年前到今天）
        function setDefaultDates() {
            const today = new Date();
            const oneYearAgo = new Date();
            oneYearAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = oneYearAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        window.onload = setDefaultDates;

        function doQuery() {
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            
            if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                alert('请选择查询日期范围');
                return;
            }
            
            if (new Date(startDate) > new Date(endDate)) {
                alert('开始日期不能大于结束日期');
                return;
            }
            
            alert('查询条件：' + startDate + ' 至 ' + endDate + '\n正在查询...');
        }

        function resetQuery() {
            setDefaultDates();
        }
    </script>
</body>

                        <li><strong>数据范围：</strong>统计持有有效对公结算账户（排除不动户、久悬户），且开户证件类型为统一社会信用代码、客户类型为非个体工商户的对公客户。</li>
                        <li><strong>时间区间：</strong>默认查询"当前日期的两年前至当日"，支持自定义起止日期（起始日期不得早于系统上线日期）。</li>
                        <li><strong>数据更新：</strong>实时查询，数据随系统核验操作动态更新。</li>
                        <li><strong>权限说明：</strong>
                            <span class="tag tag-blue">省级</span> 查看全省汇总，可下钻至州市级；
                            <span class="tag tag-green">州市级</span> 查看本市汇总，可下钻至县区级；
                            <span class="tag tag-orange">网点级</span> 仅查看本网点明细，无下钻权限。
                        </li>
                        <li><strong>导出限制：</strong>单次预览和导出最大支持 10,000 条记录，超出限制请添加机构条件缩小范围。</li>

    <script>
        // 模拟交互
        document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
            th.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
                this.classList.add('sorted');
                const icon = this.querySelector('.sort-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.textContent = icon.textContent === '↑' ? '↓' : '↑';
                }
            });
        });

        // 日期默认值设置
        const today = new Date();
        const twoYearsAgo = new Date();
        twoYearsAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 2);
        
        document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        document.getElementById('startDate').value = twoYearsAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>受益所有人核验义务机构客户清单</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary-color: #0369a1;
            --primary-light: #0ea5e9;
            --primary-dark: #075985;
            --accent-color: #0891b2;
            --success-color: #059669;
            --warning-color: #d97706;
            --danger-color: #dc2626;
            --bg-color: #f0f9ff;
            --card-bg: #ffffff;
            --text-primary: #0c4a6e;
            --text-secondary: #64748b;
            --border-color: #e0f2fe;
            --shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(3,105,161,0.1);
            --radius: 12px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0c4a6e 0%, #075985 50%, #0369a1 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .page-header {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 24px 32px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .page-title {
            font-size: 26px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .page-title .icon-wrapper {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .page-title .icon-wrapper svg {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            color: white;
        }

        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .breadcrumb a {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .breadcrumb a:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        .user-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .user-level {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            color: white;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
        }

        .card-header {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            padding: 16px 28px;
            font-size: 17px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .card-header .icon {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        .card-body {
            padding: 28px;
        }

        /* 查询条件区 */
        .query-form {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            align-items: end;
        }

        .form-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .form-label {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .form-control {
            height: 44px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            background: white;
        }

        .form-control:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(3,105,161,0.12);
        }

        .form-control::placeholder {
            color: #94a3b8;
        }

        .btn-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .btn {
            height: 44px;
            padding: 0 28px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(3,105,161,0.4);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: #e2e8f0;
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--success-color), #10b981);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-success:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(5,150,105,0.4);
        }

        /* 提示信息 */
        .alert {
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 13px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .alert-info {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ecfeff, #e0f2fe);
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            border: 1px solid #a5f3fc;
        }

        .alert-warning {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fffbeb, #fef3c7);
            color: #92400e;
            border: 1px solid #fcd34d;
        }

        /* 统计卡片 */
        .stats-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f9ff, #e0f2fe);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 18px 20px;
            border: 1px solid #bae6fd;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-value {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
        }

        /* 表格区域 */
        .table-toolbar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .table-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .table-info strong {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .table-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .table-wrapper {
            overflow-x: auto;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        thead {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0f9ff, #e0f2fe);
        }

        th {
            padding: 16px 18px;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        th:hover {
            background: #cffafe;
        }

        th .sort-icon {
            margin-left: 6px;
            opacity: 0.4;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        th.sorted .sort-icon {
            opacity: 1;
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        td {
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        tbody tr {
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        tbody tr:hover {
            background: #f0f9ff;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
            background: #fafeff;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(even):hover {
            background: #f0f9ff;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-right {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .link {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* 分页 */
        .pagination {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 24px;
            padding-top: 20px;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .pagination-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .pagination-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .page-btn {
            min-width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            padding: 0 12px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            background: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            color: var(--primary-color);
            background: #f0f9ff;
        }

        .page-btn.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* 说明区域 */
        .description-section {
            padding: 24px 28px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fafc, #f1f5f9);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .description-title {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .description-content {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.9;
        }

        .description-content ul {
            margin-left: 22px;
        }

        .description-content li {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .description-content li strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .rule-box {
            background: white;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 18px 22px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .rule-box-title {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-color);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .rule-box ol {
            margin-left: 22px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .rule-box ol li {
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .tag-cyan {
            background: #ecfeff;
            color: #0891b2;
        }

        .tag-blue {
            background: #dbeafe;
            color: #1d4ed8;
        }

        /* 响应式 */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container {
                padding: 12px;
            }

            .header-top {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 16px;
            }

            .query-form {

            }

            .table-toolbar {

                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .stats-row {

            }
        }
    </style>

        // 模拟排序交互
        document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
            th.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
                this.classList.add('sorted');
                const icon = this.querySelector('.sort-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.textContent = icon.textContent === '↑' ? '↓' : '↑';
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>

    <style>
        :root {
            --primary-color: #7c3aed;
            --primary-light: #a78bfa;
            --primary-dark: #5b21b6;
            --accent-color: #f59e0b;

            --text-secondary: #6b7280;

            --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(124,58,237,0.12);
            --radius: 16px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #312e81 30%, #4c1d95 70%, #581c87 100%);

            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1440px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 28px;
        }

            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 28px 36px;

            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);

        .header-content {

            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;

            gap: 20px;
        }

            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
        }

        .page-icon svg {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            color: white;

        .page-title {
            font-size: 28px;

            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .page-subtitle {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .user-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .user-level {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border-radius: 25px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(124,58,237,0.25);
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            margin-bottom: 28px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        }

        .card-header {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;

            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .card-header .icon {
            width: 26px;

        .card-body {
            padding: 32px;
        }

        /* 查询条件区 */
        .query-form {
            display: grid;

            gap: 24px;
            align-items: end;
        }

        .form-group {
            display: flex;

            gap: 10px;
        }

        .form-label {
            font-size: 13px;

            gap: 10px;
        }

        .btn-primary {

        .btn-primary:hover {

            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: #ede9fe;
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--success-color), #34d399);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(16,185,129,0.3);
        }

        .btn-link {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--primary-color);
            padding: 0;
            height: auto;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .btn-link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* 提示信息 */
        .alert {
            padding: 16px 22px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            margin-top: 24px;
        }

        .alert-warning {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fef3c7, #fde68a);
            color: #92400e;
            border: 2px solid #fcd34d;
        }

        .alert-danger {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fee2e2, #fecaca);
            color: #991b1b;
            border: 2px solid #fca5a5;
        }

        /* 统计卡片 */
        .stats-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #faf5ff, #f3e8ff);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 22px 26px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .stat-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -20px;
            right: -20px;
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            background: rgba(124,58,237,0.08);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-value {
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
        }

        .stat-card.warning {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fffbeb, #fef3c7);
            border-color: #fcd34d;
        }

        .stat-card.warning .stat-value {
            color: #b45309;
        }

        .stat-card.danger {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef2f2, #fee2e2);
            border-color: #fca5a5;
        }

        .stat-card.danger .stat-value {
            color: #dc2626;
        }

        /* 表格区域 */
        .table-toolbar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .table-info {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .table-info strong {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .table-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .table-wrapper {
            overflow-x: auto;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 14px;
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        thead {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #faf5ff, #f3e8ff);
        }

        th {
            padding: 18px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        th:hover {
            background: #ede9fe;
        }

        th .sort-icon {
            margin-left: 8px;
            opacity: 0.4;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        th.sorted .sort-icon {
            opacity: 1;
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        td {
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        tbody tr {
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        tbody tr:hover {
            background: #faf5ff;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
            background: #fefbff;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(even):hover {
            background: #faf5ff;
        }

        /* 风险等级标签 */
        .risk-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 5px 14px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .risk-high {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fee2e2, #fecaca);
            color: #dc2626;
        }

        .risk-medium-high {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffedd5, #fed7aa);
            color: #ea580c;
        }

        .risk-medium {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef3c7, #fde68a);
            color: #b45309;
        }

        .risk-medium-low {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d1fae5, #a7f3d0);
            color: #059669;
        }

        .risk-low {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dbeafe, #bfdbfe);
            color: #2563eb;
        }

        /* 截止期限状态 */
        .deadline-warning {
            background: #fef3c7;
            color: #b45309;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .deadline-expired {
            background: #fee2e2;
            color: #dc2626;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-right {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .link {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* 分页 */
        .pagination {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 28px;
            padding-top: 24px;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .pagination-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .pagination-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .page-btn {
            min-width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            padding: 0 14px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            background: white;
            border-radius: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            color: var(--primary-color);
            background: #faf5ff;
        }

        .page-btn.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* 说明区域 */
        .description-section {
            padding: 28px 32px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fefbff, #f5f3ff);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .description-title {
            font-size: 17px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .description-content {

            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 2;

        .description-content ul {
            margin-left: 24px;
        }

        .description-content li {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .description-content li strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .rule-box {
            background: white;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 22px 28px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .rule-box-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-color);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .rule-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }

        .rule-table th,
        .rule-table td {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            text-align: left;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .rule-table th {
            background: #f3e8ff;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* 响应式 */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container {
                padding: 14px;
            }

            .header-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 20px;
            }

            .query-form {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .table-toolbar {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .stats-row {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
        }

                    <ul>
                        <li><strong>功能描述：</strong>筛选出未完成受益所有人核验的存量客户，明确核验期限，推动义务机构完成核验。</li>

                            <tbody>
                                <tr>
                                    <td><span class="risk-tag risk-high">高</span> <span class="risk-tag risk-medium-high">中高</span></td>
                                    <td><strong>2026年6月30日</strong></td>
                                    <td>高风险客户需优先完成核验</td>
                                </tr>
                                <tr>
                                    <td><span class="risk-tag risk-medium">中</span> <span class="risk-tag risk-medium-low">中低</span> <span class="risk-tag risk-low">低</span></td>
                                    <td><strong>2027年12月31日</strong></td>
                                    <td>中低风险客户按计划完成核验</td>
                                </tr>
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <p style="margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary);">
                            <strong>注意：</strong>客户风险等级变更时，系统将自动更新核验截止期限，并提示义务机构。
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // 模拟排序交互
        document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
            th.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
                this.classList.add('sorted');
                const icon = this.querySelector('.sort-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.textContent = icon.textContent === '↑' ? '↓' : '↑';
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

                        <li><strong>数据来源：</strong>受益所有人核验义务机构客户清单。</li>
                        <li><strong>筛选条件：</strong>该客户在全辖机构最新一次核验记录的结果状态为"核验不一致"。</li>
                        <li><strong>查询规则：</strong>支持按"义务机构码、义务机构名称、客户编号、客户名称、最新核验时间"筛选，默认按"最新核验时间"倒序排序。</li>

                        <li><strong>导出限制：</strong>单次预览和导出最大支持 10,000 条记录，超出限制请添加条件缩小范围。</li>

        // 模拟排序交互
        document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
            th.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
                this.classList.add('sorted');
                const icon = this.querySelector('.sort-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.textContent = icon.textContent === '↑' ? '↓' : '↑';
                }
            });
        });

        // 日期默认值设置
        const today = new Date();
        const twoYearsAgo = new Date();
        twoYearsAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 2);
    </script>
</body>

                        <li><strong>筛选条件：</strong>该客户在全辖机构最新一次核验记录的结果状态为"主体未备案"。</li>

                        <li><strong>导出限制：</strong>单次预览和导出最大支持 10,000 条记录，超出限制请添加条件缩小范围。</li>

                            备案完成后再进行核验操作。如客户确实无法完成备案，应按照相关规定进行风险评估和上报处理。
                        </p>

    <script>
        // 模拟排序交互
        document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
            th.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
                this.classList.add('sorted');
                const icon = this.querySelector('.sort-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.textContent = icon.textContent === '↑' ? '↓' : '↑';
                }
            });
        });

        // 日期默认值设置
        const today = new Date();
        const twoYearsAgo = new Date();
        twoYearsAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 2);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
