<script>
function cp(btn) {
  btn.classList.add('done');
  btn.innerHTML = '&#10003;';
  btn.onclick = null;
  var fv = btn.parentElement.querySelector('.fv');
  if (fv) { fv.classList.remove('empty'); fv.style.color = '#2980b9'; fv.textContent = '（已同步）'; }
  var d = btn.parentElement.querySelector('.dot');
  if (d) { d.className = 'dot g'; }
}

function cpAll(gid) {
  var g = document.getElementById(gid);
  g.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(function(b) {
    b.classList.add('done'); b.innerHTML = '&#10003;'; b.onclick = null;
  });
  g.querySelectorAll('.compare-side.local .fv').forEach(function(v) {
    if (v.classList.contains('empty') || v.style.color === 'rgb(41, 128, 185)') {
      v.classList.remove('empty'); v.style.color = '#2980b9'; v.textContent = '（已同步）';
    }
  });
  g.querySelectorAll('.compare-side.local .dot').forEach(function(d) {
    if (!d.classList.contains('g')) d.className = 'dot g';
  });
  var badge = g.querySelector('.match-badge');
  if (badge) { badge.className = 'match-badge matched'; badge.textContent = '已同步'; }
  var ab = g.querySelector('.group-actions .btn-primary');
  if (ab) { ab.textContent = '已复制'; ab.disabled = true; }
}

function addNew(gid) {
  var g = document.getElementById(gid);
  var slot = g.querySelector('.empty-slot');
  if (slot) slot.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#27ae60; font-weight:bold; padding:10px;">&#10003; 已标记新增，保存后生效</div>';
  var badge = g.querySelector('.match-badge');
  if (badge) { badge.className = 'match-badge matched'; badge.textContent = '待新增'; }
  g.querySelectorAll('.group-actions .btn-info').forEach(function(b) { b.textContent = '已标记新增'; b.disabled = true; });
}

function saveAll() {
  var t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(function() {
    t.style.display = 'none';
    alert('全部保存成功。\n\n已将 BOMIS 同步数据更新到行内客户信息系统。\n（原型演示）');
  }, 1000);
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- 页面标题 -->
        <div class="page-header">
            <h1>受益所有人信息维护</h1>
            <p>支持业务人员输入对公客户编号，查询客户基础信息后，新增/编辑受益所有人全量信息并保存</p>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 查询区域 -->
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">🔍</span>
                基础查询区
            </div>
            <div class="search-section">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>对公客户编号</label>
                    <input type="text" id="customerNo" placeholder="请输入对公客户编号">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>统一社会信用代码</label>
                    <input type="text" id="creditCode" placeholder="请输入统一社会信用代码">
                </div>
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="queryCustomer()">
                    <span>🔍</span> 查询
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 客户基础信息展示区 -->
        <div class="card" id="customerInfoCard" style="display: none;">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">📋</span>
                客户基础信息
            </div>
            <div class="info-grid">
                <div class="info-item">
                    <span class="label">客户编号：</span>
                    <span class="value" id="displayCustomerNo">-</span>
                </div>
                <div class="info-item">
                    <span class="label">客户名称：</span>
                    <span class="value" id="displayCustomerName">-</span>
                </div>
                <div class="info-item">
                    <span class="label">证件类型：</span>
                    <span class="value" id="displayIdType">-</span>
                </div>
                <div class="info-item">
                    <span class="label">证件号码：</span>
                    <span class="value" id="displayIdNo">-</span>
                </div>
                <div class="info-item-editable">
                    <span class="label">备案主体类型：</span>
                    <select id="entityType" onchange="onEntityTypeChange()">
                        <option value="">请选择备案主体类型</option>
                        <option value="enterprise">企业</option>
                        <option value="foreign_branch">外国公司分支机构</option>
                        <option value="partnership">合伙企业</option>
                        <option value="individual">个体工商户</option>
                        <option value="nonprofit">非营利组织</option>
                        <option value="other">其他</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 客户基础信息保存按钮 -->
            <div class="card-footer">
                <button class="btn btn-primary" id="saveEntityTypeBtn" onclick="saveEntityType()" disabled>
                    <span>💾</span> 保存备案主体类型
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 受益所有人列表 -->
        <div class="card" id="beneficiaryListCard" style="display: none;">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">👥</span>
                受益所有人列表
            </div>
            
            <div class="toolbar">
                <div class="toolbar-left">
                    <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="addBeneficiary()">
                        <span>➕</span> 新增受益所有人
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="importExcel()">
                        <span>📥</span> 批量导入
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="beneficiary-list">
                <table class="beneficiary-table">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>姓名</th>
                            <th>性别</th>
                            <th>出生日期</th>
                            <th>证件类型</th>
                            <th>证件号码</th>
                            <th>国籍</th>
                            <th>受益所有人状态</th>
                            <th>操作</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody id="beneficiaryTableBody">
                        <!-- 示例数据 -->
                        <tr data-id="1">
                            <td>张三</td>
                            <td>男</td>
                            <td>1980-05-15</td>
                            <td>居民身份证</td>
                            <td>110***********1234</td>
                            <td>中国</td>
                            <td>
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center;">
                                    <label class="switch-mini">
                                        <input type="checkbox" checked onchange="onStatusChange(1, this)">
                                        <span class="slider"></span>
                                    </label>
                                    <span class="status-text active" id="statusText_1">有效</span>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <td class="actions">
                                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="editBeneficiary(1)">编辑</button>
                                <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteBeneficiary(1)">删除</button>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr data-id="2">
                            <td>李四</td>
                            <td>男</td>
                            <td>1975-11-20</td>
                            <td>护照</td>
                            <td>G12345678</td>
                            <td>中国</td>

                                </div>

    <!-- 新增/编辑受益所有人模态框 -->

                        <li>若"直接或间接拥有25%以上股权"为Y，除"在华最高层级的高级管理人员"可填Y/N外，其他权益类型均需为N</li>

                    <!-- 上一层备案主体 -->

    <!-- 导入模态框 -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="importModal">
        <div class="modal" style="max-width: 500px;">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h2>批量导入受益所有人</h2>
                <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeImportModal()">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <div class="alert alert-info">
                    <span>ℹ️</span>
                    <span>请下载模板文件，按要求填写后上传</span>
                </div>
                <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <button class="btn btn-secondary">
                        <span>📄</span> 下载导入模板
                    </button>
                </div>
                <div class="file-upload" onclick="document.getElementById('fileInput').click()">
                    <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".xlsx,.xls">
                    <div class="icon">📁</div>
                    <p>点击或拖拽文件到此处上传</p>
                    <p style="margin-top: 8px;"><span>支持 .xlsx, .xls 格式</span></p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
                <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeImportModal()">取消</button>
                <button class="btn btn-primary">
                    <span>📤</span> 开始导入
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // 原始数据存储（用于检测变更）
        let originalEntityType = '';
        let originalBeneficiaryStatus = {};
        let beneficiaryListChanged = false;
        
        // 查询客户信息
        function queryCustomer() {
            const customerNo = document.getElementById('customerNo').value;
            const creditCode = document.getElementById('creditCode').value;
            
            if (!customerNo && !creditCode) {
                alert('请输入对公客户编号或统一社会信用代码');
                return;
            }
            
            // 模拟查询结果
            document.getElementById('displayCustomerNo').textContent = customerNo || 'CUST20240001';
            document.getElementById('displayCustomerName').textContent = '示例科技有限公司';
            document.getElementById('displayIdType').textContent = '统一社会信用代码';
            document.getElementById('displayIdNo').textContent = creditCode || '91110000MA01XXXXX';
            
            // 模拟设置备案主体类型（后端返回）
            document.getElementById('entityType').value = 'enterprise';
            originalEntityType = 'enterprise';
            
            // 初始化受益所有人状态
            originalBeneficiaryStatus = {
                1: true,
                2: false
            };
            beneficiaryListChanged = false;
            
            document.getElementById('customerInfoCard').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('beneficiaryListCard').style.display = 'block';
            
            // 重置保存按钮状态
            document.getElementById('saveEntityTypeBtn').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('saveBeneficiaryListBtn').disabled = true;
        }
        
        // 备案主体类型变更检测
        function onEntityTypeChange() {
            const currentValue = document.getElementById('entityType').value;
            const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveEntityTypeBtn');
            saveBtn.disabled = (currentValue === originalEntityType);
        }
        
        // 保存备案主体类型
        function saveEntityType() {
            const newValue = document.getElementById('entityType').value;
            if (!newValue) {
                alert('请选择备案主体类型');
                return;
            }
            
            // 模拟保存
            alert('备案主体类型保存成功！');
            originalEntityType = newValue;
            document.getElementById('saveEntityTypeBtn').disabled = true;
        }
        
        // 受益所有人状态变更
        function onStatusChange(id, checkbox) {
            const isChecked = checkbox.checked;
            const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText_' + id);
            
            if (isChecked) {
                statusText.textContent = '有效';
                statusText.className = 'status-text active';
            } else {
                statusText.textContent = '无效';
                statusText.className = 'status-text inactive';
            }
            
            // 检测是否有变更
            checkBeneficiaryListChanged();
        }
        
        // 检测受益所有人列表是否有变更
        function checkBeneficiaryListChanged() {
            let hasChanged = false;
            
            // 检查状态变更
            for (let id in originalBeneficiaryStatus) {
                const checkbox = document.querySelector(`tr[data-id="${id}"] .switch-mini input`);
                if (checkbox && checkbox.checked !== originalBeneficiaryStatus[id]) {
                    hasChanged = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            beneficiaryListChanged = hasChanged;
            document.getElementById('saveBeneficiaryListBtn').disabled = !hasChanged;
        }
        
        // 保存受益所有人列表
        function saveBeneficiaryList() {
            // 收集变更数据
            let changes = [];
            for (let id in originalBeneficiaryStatus) {
                const checkbox = document.querySelector(`tr[data-id="${id}"] .switch-mini input`);
                if (checkbox && checkbox.checked !== originalBeneficiaryStatus[id]) {
                    changes.push({
                        id: id,
                        newStatus: checkbox.checked ? '有效' : '无效'
                    });
                }
            }
            
            // 模拟保存
            alert('受益所有人信息保存成功！\n变更内容：\n' + changes.map(c => `ID ${c.id}: 状态变更为 ${c.newStatus}`).join('\n'));
            
            // 更新原始状态
            for (let id in originalBeneficiaryStatus) {
                const checkbox = document.querySelector(`tr[data-id="${id}"] .switch-mini input`);
                if (checkbox) {
                    originalBeneficiaryStatus[id] = checkbox.checked;
                }
            }
            
            beneficiaryListChanged = false;
            document.getElementById('saveBeneficiaryListBtn').disabled = true;
        }
        
        // 新增受益所有人
        function addBeneficiary() {
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = '新增受益所有人';
            clearModalForm();
            openModal();
        }
        
        // 编辑受益所有人
        function editBeneficiary(id) {
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = '编辑受益所有人';
            clearModalForm();
            
            // 模拟填充数据
            document.getElementById('f_name').value = '张三';
            document.getElementById('f_gender').value = 'male';
            document.getElementById('f_nationality').value = 'CHN';
            document.getElementById('f_birthday').value = '1980-05-15';
            document.getElementById('f_mobile').value = '13812345678';
            document.getElementById('f_address').value = '北京市朝阳区XX路XX号';
            document.getElementById('f_idType').value = 'id_card';
            document.getElementById('f_idNumber').value = '110101198005151234';
            document.getElementById('f_idValidTo').value = '2030-01-01';
            
            openModal();
        }
        
        // 清空模态框表单
        function clearModalForm() {
            const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#beneficiaryModal input, #beneficiaryModal select, #beneficiaryModal textarea');
            inputs.forEach(input => {
                if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
                    input.checked = false;
                } else {
                    input.value = '';
                }
                input.classList.remove('highlight-error');
            });
            
            // 隐藏所有条件字段
            document.querySelectorAll('.conditional-fields').forEach(el => {
                el.classList.remove('show');
            });
        }
        
        // 删除受益所有人
        function deleteBeneficiary(id) {
            if (confirm('确定要删除该受益所有人信息吗？此操作不可撤销。')) {
                alert('删除成功');
                // 实际应从列表中移除该行
            }
        }
        
        // 打开模态框
        function openModal() {
            document.getElementById('beneficiaryModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 关闭模态框
        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('beneficiaryModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
        
        // 导入Excel
        function importExcel() {
            document.getElementById('importModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        function closeImportModal() {
            document.getElementById('importModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
        
        // 条件显示切换函数
        function toggle25Equity() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('f_has25Equity').checked;
            document.getElementById('equity25Fields').classList.toggle('show', checked);
        }
        
        function toggleControl() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('f_hasControl').checked;
            document.getElementById('controlFields').classList.toggle('show', checked);
        }
        
        function toggleUpperEntity() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('f_hasUpperEntity').checked;
            document.getElementById('upperEntityFields').classList.toggle('show', checked);
        }
        
        function toggle25Rights() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('f_has25Rights').checked;
            document.getElementById('rights25Fields').classList.toggle('show', checked);
        }
        
        function toggleManager() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('f_isManager').checked;
            document.getElementById('managerFields').classList.toggle('show', checked);
        }
        
        function toggleChinaManager() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('f_isChinaManager').checked;
            document.getElementById('chinaManagerFields').classList.toggle('show', checked);
        }
        
        // 保存受益所有人（模态框内）
        function saveBeneficiary() {
            // 基础校验
            const requiredFields = [
                { id: 'f_name', name: '姓名' },
                { id: 'f_gender', name: '性别' },
                { id: 'f_nationality', name: '国籍' },
                { id: 'f_birthday', name: '出生日期' },
                { id: 'f_mobile', name: '联系电话（手机）' },
                { id: 'f_address', name: '经常居住地或工作单位地址' },
                { id: 'f_idValidTo', name: '证件有效期限（到期日）' },
                { id: 'f_idType', name: '证件类型' },
                { id: 'f_idNumber', name: '证件号码' }
            ];
            
            let errors = [];
            requiredFields.forEach(field => {
                const el = document.getElementById(field.id);
                if (!el.value) {
                    errors.push(field.name);
                    el.classList.add('highlight-error');
                } else {
                    el.classList.remove('highlight-error');
                }
            });
            
            // 检查至少一种权益类型
            const hasAnyRight = document.getElementById('f_has25Equity').checked ||
                               document.getElementById('f_hasControl').checked ||
                               document.getElementById('f_has25Rights').checked ||
                               document.getElementById('f_isManager').checked ||
                               document.getElementById('f_isChinaManager').checked;
            
            if (!hasAnyRight) {
                errors.push('至少选择一种受益所有权关系类型');
            }
            
            if (errors.length > 0) {
                alert('以下必填项未填写：\n' + errors.join('\n'));
                return;
            }
            
            // 模拟保存成功
            alert('保存成功！');
            closeModal();
            
            // 标记列表有变更
            beneficiaryListChanged = true;
            document.getElementById('saveBeneficiaryListBtn').disabled = false;
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- 页面标题 -->
        <div class="page-header">
            <h1>数据一致性核验与反向同步更新</h1>
            <p>核验BOMIS数据与本地留存数据一致性，支持单条数据反向同步更新，记录判定结果日志</p>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 查询区域 -->
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">🔍</span>
                核验数据查询
            </div>
            <div class="search-section">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>对公客户编号</label>
                    <input type="text" id="customerNo" placeholder="请输入对公客户编号">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>统一社会信用代码</label>
                    <input type="text" id="creditCode" placeholder="请输入统一社会信用代码">
                </div>
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="queryVerification()">
                    <span>🔍</span> 查询核验数据
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 统计卡片 -->
        <div class="stats-grid" id="statsSection" style="display: none;">
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon green">✅</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="matchCount">3</h3>
                    <p>一致项</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon yellow">⚠️</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="mismatchCount">2</h3>
                    <p>要素不一致</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon red">➖</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="localExtraCount">1</h3>
                    <p>本地多出</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-icon blue">➕</div>
                <div class="stat-info">
                    <h3 id="remoteExtraCount">1</h3>
                    <p>本地缺失</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- 数据对比区 -->
        <div class="card" id="compareSection" style="display: none;">
            <div class="card-title">
                <span class="icon">📊</span>
                数据对比结果
                <span style="margin-left: auto; font-size: 13px; font-weight: normal; color: #666;">
                    客户：<span id="displayCustomerName">示例科技有限公司</span>
                </span>
            </div>
            
            <!-- 图例 -->
            <div class="legend">
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color match"></span>
                    <span>数据一致</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color mismatch"></span>
                    <span>要素不一致</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color local-only"></span>
                    <span>本地多出</span>
                </div>
                <div class="legend-item">
                    <span class="legend-color remote-only"></span>
                    <span>本地缺失</span>
                </div>

            </div>
            <div class="modal-body" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px;">
                <div style="font-size: 64px; margin-bottom: 20px;">✅</div>
                <h3 style="color: #28a745; margin-bottom: 12px;">反向同步成功</h3>
                <p style="color: #666; font-size: 14px;" id="successMsg">已将BOMIS查询数据同步至本地</p>
                <div style="margin-top: 20px; background: #f8f9fa; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left;">
                    <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #666;">
                        <strong>操作人：</strong>admin<br>
                        <strong>操作时间：</strong><span id="successTime">2026-02-04 14:32:18</span><br>
                        <strong>同步结果：</strong>成功
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer" style="justify-content: center;">
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="closeSuccessModal()">确定</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // 查询核验数据
        function queryVerification() {
            const customerNo = document.getElementById('customerNo').value;
            const creditCode = document.getElementById('creditCode').value;
            
            if (!customerNo && !creditCode) {
                alert('请输入对公客户编号或统一社会信用代码');
                return;
            }
            
            // 显示统计和对比区域
            document.getElementById('statsSection').style.display = 'grid';
            document.getElementById('compareSection').style.display = 'block';
            const queryParam = customerNo || creditCode;
            document.getElementById('displayCustomerName').textContent = '示例科技有限公司（' + queryParam + '）';
        }
        
        // 同步单个字段
        function syncField(fieldName, source) {
            document.getElementById('syncConfirmModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 同步整条数据
        function syncAllFields(id) {
            document.getElementById('syncConfirmModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 关闭同步确认模态框
        function closeSyncModal() {
            document.getElementById('syncConfirmModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            document.getElementById('confirmCheck').checked = false;
            document.getElementById('executeSyncBtn').disabled = true;
        }
        
        // 确认复选框变化
        document.getElementById('confirmCheck').addEventListener('change', function() {
            document.getElementById('executeSyncBtn').disabled = !this.checked;
        });
        
        // 执行同步
        function executSync() {
            closeSyncModal();
            // 显示成功提示
            document.getElementById('successTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN');
            document.getElementById('successModal').classList.add('show');
        }
        
        // 关闭成功提示
        function closeSuccessModal() {
            document.getElementById('successModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
        
        // 删除本地数据
        function deleteLocalData(id) {
            if (confirm('确定要删除该受益所有人的本地数据吗？此操作将记录在操作日志中。')) {
                alert('删除成功，已记录操作日志');
            }
        }
        
        // 一键录入
        function quickImport(id) {
            if (confirm('确定要将BOMIS查询数据一键录入到本地系统吗？')) {
                document.getElementById('successMsg').textContent = '已将BOMIS查询数据录入本地系统';
                document.getElementById('successTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN');
                document.getElementById('successModal').classList.add('show');
            }
        }
        
        // 确认本地数据有效
        function confirmLocalData() {
            if (confirm('确认本地数据有效？此操作将标记当前数据为已核验状态。')) {
                alert('已确认本地数据有效，操作已记录');
            }
        }
        
        // 保存反向同步数据
        function saveReverseSync() {
            // 校验数据
            alert('数据校验通过，保存成功！已记录操作日志。');
        }
        
        // 显示日志模态框
        function showLogModal() {
            document.getElementById('logModal').classList.add('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        // 关闭日志模态框
        function closeLogModal() {
            document.getElementById('logModal').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
        
        // 导出日志
        function exportLog() {
            alert('日志导出功能开发中...');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

- 文件类型: .html

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>系统通知查询</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary-color: #2563eb;
            --primary-light: #3b82f6;
            --primary-dark: #1d4ed8;
            --accent-color: #0ea5e9;
            --success-color: #10b981;
            --warning-color: #f59e0b;
            --danger-color: #ef4444;
            --bg-color: #f8fafc;
            --card-bg: #ffffff;
            --text-primary: #1e293b;
            --text-secondary: #64748b;
            --border-color: #e2e8f0;
            --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(37,99,235,0.1);
            --radius: 12px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a8a 0%, #1e40af 40%, #2563eb 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .page-header {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.97);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 24px 32px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .page-title-section {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .page-icon {
            width: 52px;
            height: 52px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;

            font-size: 14px;

        .card {

            padding: 28px;
        }

        /* 查询条件区 */
        .query-form {

        }

            background: #e2e8f0;
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--success-color), #34d399);
            color: white;
        }

        /* 表格区域 */
        .table-toolbar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .table-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .table-info strong {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .table-wrapper {
            overflow-x: auto;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        thead {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fafc, #f1f5f9);

        th {
            padding: 16px 18px;

        td {

            }

                align-items: flex-start;
            }
        }

                        <li><strong>默认查询：</strong>进入页面后默认展示从1年前到当前日期的数据。</li>
                        <li><strong>数据更新：</strong>数据实时查询，随系统通知发布动态更新。</li>
                    </ul>

    <script>
        // 设置默认日期（1年前到今天）
        function setDefaultDates() {
            const today = new Date();
            const oneYearAgo = new Date();
            oneYearAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = oneYearAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        // 页面加载时设置默认日期
        window.onload = setDefaultDates;

        // 查询功能
        function doQuery() {
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            
            if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                alert('请选择查询日期范围');
                return;
            }
            
            if (new Date(startDate) > new Date(endDate)) {
                alert('开始日期不能大于结束日期');
                return;
            }
            
            // 模拟查询
            alert('查询条件：' + startDate + ' 至 ' + endDate + '\n正在查询...');
        }

        // 重置查询
        function resetQuery() {
            setDefaultDates();
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        /* 附件链接 */
        .attachment-link {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            background: #ecfdf5;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .attachment-link:hover {
            background: #d1fae5;
        }

        .attachment-link svg {
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
        }

        .no-attachment {
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        /* 类型标签 */
        .type-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .type-notice {
            background: #dbeafe;
            color: #1d4ed8;
        }

        .type-alert {
            background: #fef3c7;
            color: #b45309;
        }

        .type-update {
            background: #dcfce7;
            color: #16a34a;
        }

        .type-remind {
            background: #fce7f3;
            color: #be185d;
        }

        /* 分页 */
        .pagination {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 24px;
            padding-top: 20px;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .pagination-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .pagination-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .page-btn {
            min-width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            padding: 0 12px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            background: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn.active {
            background: var(--primary-color);
            color: white;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* 说明区域 */
        .description-section {
            padding: 22px 30px;
            background: #f0fdf4;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .description-title {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .description-content {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.9;
        }

        .description-content ul {
            margin-left: 22px;
        }

        .description-content li {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        /* 弹窗样式 */
        .modal-overlay {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            z-index: 1000;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }

        .modal-overlay.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal {
            background: white;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 650px;
            max-height: 80vh;
            overflow: hidden;
            animation: modalSlideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlideIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-30px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .modal-header {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            padding: 18px 24px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .modal-title {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .modal-close {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border: none;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        .modal-close:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
        }

        .modal-body {
            padding: 24px;
            max-height: 420px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .attachment-list {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .attachment-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            background: #f0fdf4;
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .attachment-item:hover {
            background: #dcfce7;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .attachment-item:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .attachment-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .attachment-icon {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
        }

        .attachment-details {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .attachment-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .attachment-meta {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .download-btn {
            padding: 10px 18px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--info-color), #38bdf8);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .download-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(14,165,233,0.4);
        }

        /* 响应式 */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container {
                padding: 12px;
            }

            .page-header {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 16px;
            }

            .query-form {
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            .date-range {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <!-- 页面头部 -->
        <div class="page-header">
            <div class="page-title-section">
                <div class="page-icon">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M4 4h16c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v12c0 1.1-.9 2-2 2H4c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V6c0-1.1.9-2 2-2z"></path>
                        <polyline points="22,6 12,13 2,6"></polyline>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h1 class="page-title">业务通知查询</h1>
                    <p class="page-subtitle">查询业务通知信息，支持附件下载</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 查询条件区 -->
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-header">
                <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                    <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
                    <path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"></path>
                </svg>
                查询条件
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <form class="query-form">
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label class="form-label">查询日期范围 <span class="required">*</span></label>
                        <div class="date-range">
                            <input type="date" class="form-control" id="startDate">
                            <span class="date-separator">至</span>
                            <input type="date" class="form-control" id="endDate">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label class="form-label">&nbsp;</label>
                        <div class="btn-group">
                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="doQuery()">
                                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                    <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
                                    <path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"></path>
                                </svg>
                                查询
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="resetQuery()">
                                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                    <path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"></path>
                                    <path d="M3 3v5h5"></path>
                                </svg>
                                重置
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </form>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 数据展示区 -->
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-header">
                <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                    <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path>
                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline>
                </svg>
                业务通知数据
            </div>
            <div class="card-body">
                <div class="table-toolbar">
                    <div class="table-info">
                        共查询到 <strong>89</strong> 条记录，当前显示第 <strong>1-20</strong> 条
                    </div>
                    <div class="table-actions">
                        <button class="btn btn-success">
                            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path>
                                <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline>
                                <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line>
                            </svg>
                            导出Excel
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="table-wrapper">
                    <table>
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th>序号</th>
                                <th>业务通知类型</th>
                                <th>业务通知类型内容</th>
                                <th>通知发送时间</th>
                                <th>创建时间</th>
                                <th>更新时间</th>
                                <th>文件类型</th>
                                <th class="text-right">文件长度</th>
                                <th>备注</th>
                                <th class="text-center">附件</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            <tr>
                                <td>1</td>
                                <td><span class="type-tag type-notice">政策通知</span></td>
                                <td>受益所有人核验新规解读</td>
                                <td>2026-02-04 15:30:00</td>
                                <td>2026-02-04 15:00:00</td>
                                <td>2026-02-04 15:30:00</td>
                                <td>PDF</td>
                                <td class="text-right">2.5 MB</td>
                                <td>请各机构认真学习</td>
                                <td class="text-center">
                                    <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="attachment-link" onclick="openAttachmentModal('政策通知', 1)">
                                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                            <path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        附件
                                    </a>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td>2</td>
                                <td><span class="type-tag type-alert">风险提示</span></td>
                                <td>高风险客户核验提醒</td>
                                <td>2026-02-02 10:00:00</td>
                                <td>2026-02-02 09:30:00</td>
                                <td>2026-02-02 10:00:00</td>
                                <td>-</td>
                                <td class="text-right">-</td>
                                <td>请及时处理</td>
                                <td class="text-center">
                                    <span class="no-attachment">无附件</span>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td>3</td>
                                <td><span class="type-tag type-update">数据更新</span></td>
                                <td>季度义务机构清单更新</td>
                                <td>2026-01-31 18:00:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-31 17:30:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-31 18:00:00</td>
                                <td>XLSX</td>
                                <td class="text-right">1.8 MB</td>
                                <td>2025Q4清单</td>
                                <td class="text-center">
                                    <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="attachment-link" onclick="openAttachmentModal('数据更新', 3)">
                                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                            <path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        附件
                                    </a>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td>4</td>
                                <td><span class="type-tag type-remind">到期提醒</span></td>
                                <td>存量客户核验截止提醒</td>
                                <td>2026-01-25 09:00:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-25 08:30:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-25 09:00:00</td>
                                <td>PDF</td>
                                <td class="text-right">560 KB</td>
                                <td>高风险客户优先</td>
                                <td class="text-center">
                                    <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="attachment-link" onclick="openAttachmentModal('到期提醒', 4)">
                                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                            <path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        附件
                                    </a>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td>5</td>
                                <td><span class="type-tag type-notice">政策通知</span></td>
                                <td>年度核验工作总结要求</td>
                                <td>2026-01-20 14:00:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-20 13:30:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-20 14:00:00</td>
                                <td>DOCX</td>
                                <td class="text-right">890 KB</td>
                                <td>请按时提交</td>
                                <td class="text-center">
                                    <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="attachment-link" onclick="openAttachmentModal('政策通知', 5)">
                                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                            <path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        附件
                                    </a>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                                <td>6</td>
                                <td><span class="type-tag type-alert">风险提示</span></td>

                                <td>2026-01-15 10:30:00</td>
                                <td>2026-01-15 11:00:00</td>
                                <td>-</td>
                                <td class="text-right">-</td>
                                <td>重要通知</td>
                                <td class="text-center">
                                    <span class="no-attachment">无附件</span>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
                <div class="pagination">
                    <div class="pagination-info">
                        每页显示
                        <select class="form-control" style="width: 75px; height: 38px; display: inline-block; margin: 0 8px;">
                            <option>20</option>
                            <option>50</option>
                            <option>100</option>
                        </select>
                        条
                    </div>
                    <div class="pagination-controls">
                        <button class="page-btn" disabled>首页</button>
                        <button class="page-btn" disabled>上一页</button>
                        <button class="page-btn active">1</button>
                        <button class="page-btn">2</button>
                        <button class="page-btn">3</button>
                        <button class="page-btn">4</button>
                        <button class="page-btn">5</button>
                        <button class="page-btn">下一页</button>
                        <button class="page-btn">末页</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 说明区域 -->
            <div class="description-section">
                <div class="description-title">
                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
                        <path d="M12 16v-4"></path>
                        <path d="M12 8h.01"></path>
                    </svg>
                    功能说明
                </div>
                <div class="description-content">
                    <ul>
                        <li><strong>功能描述：</strong>查询业务通知信息，包含通知类型、内容、文件信息等，支持附件下载。</li>
                        <li><strong>默认查询：</strong>进入页面后默认展示从1年前到当前日期的数据。</li>
                        <li><strong>通知类型：</strong>包括政策通知、风险提示、数据更新、到期提醒等类型。</li>
                        <li><strong>附件下载：</strong>点击"附件"链接可查看附件列表，再次点击可下载对应附件。</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 附件弹窗 -->
    <div class="modal-overlay" id="attachmentModal">
        <div class="modal">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <div class="modal-title">
                    <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span id="modalTitle">附件列表</span>
                </div>
                <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeAttachmentModal()">
                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
                        <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <ul class="attachment-list" id="attachmentList">
                    <!-- 附件列表将由JS动态生成 -->
                </ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // 设置默认日期（1年前到今天）
        function setDefaultDates() {
            const today = new Date();
            const oneYearAgo = new Date();
            oneYearAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = oneYearAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        window.onload = setDefaultDates;

        function doQuery() {
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            
            if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                alert('请选择查询日期范围');
                return;
            }
            
            if (new Date(startDate) > new Date(endDate)) {
                alert('开始日期不能大于结束日期');
                return;
            }
            
            alert('查询条件：' + startDate + ' 至 ' + endDate + '\n正在查询...');
        }

        function resetQuery() {
            setDefaultDates();
        }

        // 模拟附件数据
        const attachmentData = {
            1: [
                { name: '受益所有人核验新规解读.pdf', size: '2.5 MB', type: 'PDF' },
                { name: '新规要点汇总.docx', size: '680 KB', type: 'DOCX' }
            ],
            3: [
                { name: '2025Q4义务机构客户清单.xlsx', size: '1.8 MB', type: 'XLSX' }
            ],
            4: [
                { name: '存量客户核验截止提醒通知.pdf', size: '560 KB', type: 'PDF' },
                { name: '高风险客户名单.xlsx', size: '320 KB', type: 'XLSX' }
            ],
            5: [
                { name: '年度核验工作总结模板.docx', size: '890 KB', type: 'DOCX' },
                { name: '填报说明.pdf', size: '450 KB', type: 'PDF' }
            ]
        };

        function openAttachmentModal(title, id) {
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = title + ' - 附件列表';
            
            const attachments = attachmentData[id] || [];
            const listHtml = attachments.map(att => `
                <li class="attachment-item">
                    <div class="attachment-info">
                        <div class="attachment-icon">
                            <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path>
                                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div class="attachment-details">
                            <span class="attachment-name">${att.name}</span>
                            <span class="attachment-meta">${att.type} · ${att.size}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button class="download-btn" onclick="downloadFile('${att.name}')">
                        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path>
                            <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline>
                            <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line>
                        </svg>
                        下载
                    </button>
                </li>
            `).join('');
            
            document.getElementById('attachmentList').innerHTML = listHtml;
            document.getElementById('attachmentModal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeAttachmentModal() {
            document.getElementById('attachmentModal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        function downloadFile(filename) {
            alert('正在下载：' + filename);
        }

        document.getElementById('attachmentModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) {
                closeAttachmentModal();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeAttachmentModal();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

    <script>
        // 设置默认日期（1年前到今天）
        function setDefaultDates() {
            const today = new Date();
            const oneYearAgo = new Date();
            oneYearAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 1);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = oneYearAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        window.onload = setDefaultDates;

        function doQuery() {
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            
            if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                alert('请选择查询日期范围');
                return;
            }
            
            if (new Date(startDate) > new Date(endDate)) {
                alert('开始日期不能大于结束日期');
                return;
            }
            
            alert('查询条件：' + startDate + ' 至 ' + endDate + '\n正在查询...');
        }

        function resetQuery() {
            setDefaultDates();
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            width: 6px;
            height: 28px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .user-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .user-level {
            background: var(--primary-light);
            color: white;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .card-header {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            padding: 14px 24px;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .card-header .icon {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        .card-body {
            padding: 24px;
        }

        /* 查询条件区 */
        .query-form {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            align-items: end;
        }

        .form-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .form-label {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .form-label .required {
            color: var(--danger-color);
            margin-left: 2px;
        }

        .form-control {
            height: 40px;
            padding: 0 14px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            background: white;
        }

        .form-control:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26,95,180,0.15);
        }

        .date-range {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .date-range input {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .date-separator {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .btn-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            padding-top: 4px;
        }

        .btn {
            height: 40px;
            padding: 0 24px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(26,95,180,0.35);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: #ebebeb;
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--success-color), #57e389);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-success:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(46,194,126,0.35);
        }

        /* 提示信息 */
        .alert {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 13px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .alert-info {
            background: #e5f3ff;
            color: #0d3b75;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--primary-color);
        }

        .alert-warning {
            background: #fff8e5;
            color: #7a5c00;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--warning-color);
        }

        /* 表格区域 */
        .table-toolbar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .table-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .table-info strong {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .table-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .table-wrapper {
            overflow-x: auto;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        thead {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8f7f6, #f0efed);
        }

        th {
            padding: 14px 16px;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }

        th:hover {
            background: #ebebeb;
        }

        th .sort-icon {
            margin-left: 4px;
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        th.sorted .sort-icon {
            opacity: 1;
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        td {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        tbody tr {
            transition: background 0.15s;
        }

        tbody tr:hover {
            background: #f8f7f6;
        }

        tbody tr.summary-row {
            background: #fff0f0;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        tbody tr.summary-row td {
            color: var(--danger-color);
        }

        .text-center {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .text-right {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .drilldown-link {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .drilldown-link:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        /* 分页 */
        .pagination {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 20px;
            padding-top: 16px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .pagination-info {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .pagination-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .page-btn {
            min-width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            padding: 0 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            background: white;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn.active {
            background: var(--primary-color);
            color: white;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        .page-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        /* 说明区域 */
        .description-section {
            padding: 20px 24px;
            background: #fafafa;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .description-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .description-content {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .description-content ul {
            margin-left: 20px;
        }

        .description-content li {
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .tag-blue {
            background: #dbeafe;
            color: #1e40af;
        }

        .tag-green {
            background: #dcfce7;
            color: #166534;
        }

        .tag-orange {
            background: #ffedd5;
            color: #9a3412;
        }

        /* 响应式 */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .container {
                padding: 12px;
            }

            .page-header {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 12px;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .query-form {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .table-toolbar {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }
        }
    </style>

                        <li><strong>数据范围：</strong>统计持有有效对公结算账户（排除不动户、久悬户），且开户证件类型为统一社会信用代码、客户类型为非个体工商户的对公客户。</li>
                        <li><strong>时间区间：</strong>默认查询"当前日期的两年前至当日"，支持自定义起止日期（起始日期不得早于系统上线日期）。</li>
                        <li><strong>数据更新：</strong>实时查询，数据随系统核验操作动态更新。</li>
                        <li><strong>权限说明：</strong>
                            <span class="tag tag-blue">省级</span> 查看全省汇总，可下钻至州市级；
                            <span class="tag tag-green">州市级</span> 查看本市汇总，可下钻至县区级；
                            <span class="tag tag-orange">网点级</span> 仅查看本网点明细，无下钻权限。
                        </li>
                        <li><strong>导出限制：</strong>单次预览和导出最大支持 10,000 条记录，超出限制请添加机构条件缩小范围。</li>

    <script>
        // 模拟交互
        document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th => {
            th.addEventListener('click', function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
                this.classList.add('sorted');
                const icon = this.querySelector('.sort-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.textContent = icon.textContent === '↑' ? '↓' : '↑';
                }
            });
        });

        // 日期默认值设置
        const today = new Date();
        const twoYearsAgo = new Date();
        twoYearsAgo.setFullYear(today.getFullYear() - 2);
        
        document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        document.getElementById('startDate').value = twoYearsAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>

    <title>受益所有人核验义务机构客户清单</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary-color: #0369a1;
            --primary-light: #0ea5e9;
            --primary-dark: #075985;
            --accent-color: #0891b2;

            --warning-color: #d97706;
            --danger-color: #dc2626;
            --bg-color: #f0f9ff;
            --card-bg: #ffffff;
            --text-primary: #0c4a6e;
            --text-secondary: #64748b;
            --border-color: #e0f2fe;
            --shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(3,105,161,0.1);
            --radius: 12px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0c4a6e 0%, #075985 50%, #0369a1 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .page-header {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 24px 32px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .page-title {
            font-size: 26px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .page-title .icon-wrapper {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .page-title .icon-wrapper svg {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            color: white;
        }

        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .breadcrumb a {
            color: var(--primary-color);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .breadcrumb a:hover {
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        .user-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .user-level {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--accent-color));
            color: white;
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
        }

        .card-header {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
            padding: 16px 28px;
            font-size: 17px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .card-header .icon {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        .card-body {
            padding: 28px;
        }

        /* 查询条件区 */
        .query-form {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            align-items: end;
        }

        .form-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .form-label {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .form-control {
            height: 44px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            background: white;
        }

        .form-control:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--primary-color);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(3,105,161,0.12);
        }

        .form-control::placeholder {
            color: #94a3b8;
        }

        .btn-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .btn {
            height: 44px;
            padding: 0 28px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-color), var(--primary-light));
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(3,105,161,0.4);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: #e2e8f0;
        }

        .btn-success {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--success-color), #10b981);
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-success:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(5,150,105,0.4);
        }

        /* 提示信息 */
        .alert {
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 13px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .alert-info {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ecfeff, #e0f2fe);
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            border: 1px solid #a5f3fc;
        }

        .alert-warning {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fffbeb, #fef3c7);
            color: #92400e;
            border: 1px solid #fcd34d;
        }

        /* 统计卡片 */
        .stats-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f9ff, #e0f2fe);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 18px 20px;

        .stat-card .stat-value {

            font-weight: 700;

        /* 表格区域 */
        .table-toolbar {

        .table-info {

            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .table-info strong {

        table {

            opacity: 0.4;
            font-size: 12px;

        th.sorted .sort-icon {

            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        td {
